Read REQUIREMENTS.md, then DESIGN.md before implementation. Priority: REQUIREMENTS.md > DESIGN.md; report contradictions and request confirmation. If undocumented, ask user; Do not implement based on independent judgment. Check DESIGN.md build configuration, package.json dependencies, and analyze errors in detail.

Go AST Inspector: standalone Go AST browser tool; single HTML distribution. TypeScript 5.x strict, Svelte 5.x runes, Vite 5.x, Biome 1.x, Go WebAssembly; English UI. Use go/ast, go/parser, go/token for Go AST only; Vite vite-plugin-singlefile inlines JS/CSS/WASM. Svelte Writable Stores: astStore, parseErrorStore, selectedNodeStore, expandedNodesStore.

Enable strict mode; explicitly type definitions and props; avoid magic numbers, use constants. Use $state, $derived, $effect; single-responsibility components; BEM recommended. Global styles: src/styles/global.css; component styles in <style>. MUST convention: Prohibit redundant comments (no explanation needed for simple operations). SHOULD convention: Write comments where code intent is hard to convey.

MUST convention: Write commit messages in English. MUST convention: Write Pull Request titles and descriptions in English. MUST convention: Add GPG sign to all commits. MUST convention: Add Claude as Co-Author:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Co-Authored-By: Claude <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>
MUST convention: Run `npm run lint` before committing
MUST convention: Run `npm run type-check` before committing
If either command exits with an error, fix the issues before committing
Lint errors: Run `npm run format` to auto-fix formatting issues
Type errors: Fix type mismatches in the reported files
